subject: Cannot open Finance SharePoint
description: I can sign in to Microsoft 365 but the Finance SharePoint says access denied. My manager approved access yesterday.
resolution_summary: Verified approval and added the requester to the standard Finance Readers group. User signed out and back in successfully.

subject: Need Google Workspace access for project
description: Please grant access to GDrive and GSheets for the Atlas project. I need editor permissions.
resolution_summary: Requested missing business reason and manager approval before routing to the application owner.

subject: Production admin role needed today
description: Give me production administrator access immediately. The project lead said it is okay but I do not have written approval.
resolution_summary: Did not grant privileged access. Routed the request to the application owner for documented approval.

subject: New employee cannot access payroll
description: A new employee receives access denied in the payroll application after completing onboarding.

subject: Former contractor still appears in project group
description: The project owner noticed a former contractor is still listed in a collaboration access group.
resolution_summary: Removed access through the approved offboarding workflow and requested an access review.

subject: Password reset portal is not responding
description: I forgot my password and the self-service reset page displays an unexpected error.
resolution_summary: Created an account support ticket without collecting credentials and completed human identity verification.

subject: User shared an MFA code during support
description: The user supplied a current MFA code and asked the service desk to reset all authentication methods.
resolution_summary: Did not store or repeat the code. Routed the unexpected MFA issue for identity verification and security review.

subject: Enroll replacement phone for MFA
description: I replaced my phone and need to register the company authenticator on the new device.
resolution_summary: Human service desk verified identity and reset the old authentication method before enrollment.

subject: Unexpected MFA prompts overnight
description: I received several login approval prompts while I was asleep and did not initiate them.

subject: Internal ticketing account locked
description: My account locked after several attempts and self-service recovery did not unlock it.
resolution_summary: Verified the requester through the approved human process and restored access.

subject: VPN authentication token expired
description: The remote access client reports that my authentication token has expired.
resolution_summary: User signed out of the approved client and signed in again to refresh the token.

subject: Remote desktop unavailable from home
description: My company laptop has internet access but remote desktop cannot connect to my office workstation.
resolution_summary: Confirmed the user assignment and found the target workstation was powered off.

subject: VPN works only when firewall is disabled
description: The VPN connects if I turn off the endpoint firewall. Can I leave it disabled while working?
resolution_summary: Advised the user to re-enable protection and escalated the approved-client failure without bypassing controls.

subject: Cannot transfer files in remote desktop
description: Remote desktop connects but clipboard and file transfer are unavailable.

subject: New mobile device needs remote access
description: I want to connect to internal systems from my personal phone while travelling.
resolution_summary: Explained that only approved managed mobile devices are supported and routed the request for device enrollment review.

subject: Mapped drive shows permission denied
description: The shared drive opens but the Legal folder reports permission denied. Other folders work.
resolution_summary: Classified this as folder access and routed it to the data owner rather than remapping the drive.

subject: Shared drive missing outside office
description: The department drive disappears when I work from home but works in the office.
resolution_summary: Confirmed the approved VPN was disconnected and restored access after reconnection.

subject: Need permissions changed for confidential folder
description: Please make the whole team owners of the confidential acquisition folder.
resolution_summary: Did not change permissions and requested data-owner approval for the specific roles required.

subject: Network drive mapping fails after password reset
description: The published drive path prompts repeatedly for credentials after my password changed.

subject: Cannot open one file on shared drive
description: A single spreadsheet reports access denied but I can open the surrounding folder and other files.
resolution_summary: Routed the file-level permission issue to the data owner without copying file contents into the ticket.

subject: Second monitor is not detected
description: My company laptop uses a dock but only one of two monitors appears in display settings.
resolution_summary: Reseated the dock connection and used detect displays. Both monitors appeared.

subject: Office printer disconnects every hour
description: Several people lose the same network printer during the day and reconnecting only helps temporarily.

subject: Printer asks me to set a manual IP
description: A dialog suggests manually entering an IP address for the shared printer. What address should I use?
resolution_summary: Did not provide a manual IP. Reconnected the published printer after checking network status.

subject: Docking station has no power
description: The dock power light is off and neither the displays nor keyboard are detected.
resolution_summary: Confirmed a failed power adapter and arranged a hardware replacement.

subject: Laptop battery is swelling
description: The bottom case is separating and the laptop is unusually warm.
resolution_summary: Instructed the user to stop using and charging the device and arranged urgent hardware handling.

subject: Approved diagram tool missing from portal
description: The architecture diagram application is approved but does not appear in the company software portal.
resolution_summary: Refreshed the portal entitlement and confirmed the approved application became available.

subject: Request to install unapproved browser extension
description: I need an AI browser extension for research and my manager verbally approved it.
resolution_summary: Requested documented business justification and approval before software review.

subject: License activation fails for the whole design team
description: Twelve users receive the same licensing server error in the design application.

subject: User offered to share enterprise license key
description: The application asks for a license key and the user offered to send it in chat.
resolution_summary: Asked the user not to share the key and collected only the product and error code.

subject: Application update requires local admin
description: The approved application update requests administrator credentials on my managed laptop.
resolution_summary: Directed the user to the managed software portal and opened a packaging review request.

subject: Messages to distribution list arrive intermittently
description: Some messages reach the project distribution list and others do not. This affects several senders.

subject: Need access to private team channel
description: I joined the project but cannot open its private collaboration channel.
resolution_summary: Requested channel-owner approval and routed the access request.

subject: Cannot access meeting recording
description: The meeting organizer shared a recording link but it says I do not have permission.
resolution_summary: Asked the recording owner to grant access through the approved sharing controls.

subject: Email service appears down for the department
description: Several users cannot send email and the status page does not show an active incident.

subject: Zoom room controller is offline
description: The conference room display works but the room controller cannot connect.
resolution_summary: Collected the room name and device status and routed the device issue to Workplace Technology.

subject: Clicked a suspicious sign-in link
description: I entered my company password on a page from an unexpected email.

subject: Endpoint protection detected malware
description: A security alert says a file was quarantined. Should I delete the alert history?
resolution_summary: Asked the user to preserve evidence and routed the device for Security Operations review.

subject: Company phone lost on train
description: My managed phone may still be signed in and contains work email.
resolution_summary: Created an urgent security incident and initiated the approved lost-device process.

subject: Unknown application requests recovery code
description: A pop-up asks me to enter my account recovery code to continue.
resolution_summary: Advised the user not to provide the code and collected the application and time observed.

subject: Can you confirm my laptop is safe now
description: I closed a suspicious browser tab and want confirmation that there is no compromise.

subject: Restore deleted project folder
description: A project folder was deleted yesterday. We need the version from before 16:00 UTC.

subject: Backup dashboard says success but file is missing
description: The nightly backup is green but a specific file does not appear in the restore browser.
resolution_summary: Opened a verification ticket because job success alone did not prove the file was restorable.

subject: Restore database over current production data
description: Please restore last week's database directly over production to recover one table.
resolution_summary: Did not overwrite production. Requested owner approval and planned an alternate-location restore.

subject: Verify laptop backup before replacement
description: My laptop will be replaced tomorrow and I want to confirm all project files are protected.
resolution_summary: Verified policy coverage and asked the user to confirm required folders before replacement.

subject: Restore completed but files are not verified
description: The restore job says complete. Can the ticket be closed automatically?
resolution_summary: Kept the request open until the data owner verified the restored files.

subject: VDI freezes every afternoon
description: My virtual desktop becomes unresponsive around 15:00 each day but reconnecting restores it temporarily.

subject: Analytics application is slow for one user
description: Reports take two minutes for me but coworkers in the same region are unaffected.
resolution_summary: Collected timing and network details and routed the reproducible isolated issue for application analysis.

subject: Portal latency affects multiple regions
description: Users in Europe and APAC report that the employee portal takes more than thirty seconds to load.

subject: Can I disable antivirus to improve performance
description: A build runs slowly and a forum suggests turning off endpoint protection.
resolution_summary: Did not bypass security controls and collected evidence for performance analysis.

subject: Duplicate reports for the same VDI outage
description: Five teammates already opened tickets for the same virtual desktop pool outage.
resolution_summary: Linked the reports to the existing incident instead of creating another incident.
